title: Etaleness at a point descends along a faithfully flat field extension
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], f:X\to Y a morphism of k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions], x\in X, and x_K\in X_K a point above x. If the base-change morphism f_K:X_K\to Y_K [def-pc-base-change] is etale at x_K [def-weil-etale-morphism], then f is etale at x. Here etale at a point means etale on some open neighbourhood of that point.

source.place: pointwise analogue of Descent, Tag 02VN (etale is fpqc local on the base), using Varieties, Tag 0C4Y (\mathcal{O}_{X,x}\to\mathcal{O}_{X_K,x_K} faithfully flat); no Stacks tag states the pointwise version
